claim.title: Large init overfits: training error <1e-4 but test error ~1e-1 (Fig. 2)
claim.statement: With α=1.0, training error falls below 1e-4 while test error stays on the order of 1e-1. With α=1e-3, test error is much lower.
claim.test_plan: Use d=100, r=5, m=5dr, η=0.0025, and run 2e4 GD iterations for α=1 and α=1e-3 over 3 seeds. Track training and test error.
claim.success_criterion: For α=1, training error <1e-4 and test error ~1e-1 (between 1e-2 and 1). Test error for α=1e-3 is lower than for α=1.
